title: DriveMLP: When Training Strategy Outperforms Model Complexity in Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.29676v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning motion planning policies that remain reliable under closed-loop execution is a central challenge in Autonomous Driving (AD). Imitation Learning (IL) scales well to large AD datasets but suffers from distribution shift, causal confusion, and compounding errors under closed-loop execution. In contrast, Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically requires handcrafted rule-based rewards and massive simulation. We study a simple closed-loop IL framework that uses RL purely as an optimization tool, guided by a trajectory-distance reward derived from logged expert data. We refer to this training strategy as Expert-Guided RL (EGRL). Through a controlled empirical study we find evidence that the training procedure, rather than model size and complexity, accounts for a substantial part of the performance gains. translated_title: DriveMLP：当训练策略超越模型复杂度时——自动驾驶中的发现
translated_abstract: 学习在闭环执行下保持可靠的运动规划策略是自动驾驶（AD）中的核心挑战。模仿学习（IL）可以很好地扩展到大型自动驾驶数据集，但在闭环执行下存在分布偏移、因果混淆和误差累积等问题。相比之下，强化学习（RL）通常需要手工设计的基于规则的奖励和大规模仿真。我们研究了一种简单的闭环模仿学习框架，该框架将强化学习纯粹用作优化工具，并由从记录的专家数据中导出的轨迹距离奖励来引导。我们将这种训练策略称为专家引导强化学习（EGRL）。通过受控的实证研究，我们发现证据表明，性能提升的很大一部分来自于训练过程本身，而非模型的大小和复杂度。随后，我们提出了DriveMLP，一个使用EGRL训练的轻量级MLP策略，作为这些发现的简单实例化。它取得了…
tldr: 该论文提出专家引导强化学习（EGRL）训练策略，并训练出轻量级的DriveMLP策略，证明在自动驾驶闭环运动规划中，训练方法而非模型复杂度才是性能提升的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Expert-Guided RL (EGRL), a training strategy that uses RL purely as an optimization tool, and shows through a lightweight MLP policy (DriveMLP) that training procedure, rather than model complexity, accounts for the major performance gains in closed-loop autonomous driving planning.
